description: A white flying whale up to 15m long that lives around the Floating Masses, hides among the clouds and feeds on small birds, rarely attacking humanoids.

name: Hydra

abilities.description: Any section that takes fire-type damage gets no benefit from [Regeneration] in that round.

abilities.name: Head Reviving
abilities.summary: Brings a Neck at 0 HP or less back to 1 HP for 20 of the Body's HP.
abilities.description: The Body restores a Neck section that is at 0 HP or less to 1 HP, and that Neck may act right away. It costs the Body section 20 HP and cannot be used if that would take the Body to 0 HP or less.

abilities.name: Limited Attacks
abilities.summary: No more than two Bite attacks per round against the same target.
abilities.description: The Necks may make at most two Bite attacks against any one target in a single round.

abilities.description: Its Bite attacks can target any character within Range 1(10m), regardless of skirmishes.

abilities.name: Substitution
abilities.summary: A Neck can take the damage of a melee or ranged attack on the Body.
abilities.description: When a melee or ranged attack damages the Body, a Neck may suffer that damage in its place, exactly as calculated for the Body (no recalculation). Each Neck can do this once per round, and never against area or multi-target attacks, even melee or ranged ones.

description: A beast about 10m long with many snake heads, usually 7-9, each with a mind of its own; it lurks in lakes and swamps with only the heads showing and keeps regrowing heads unless the wounds are burned.

abilities.description: When the Mouth's attack hits, one section of the worm recovers HP equal to the damage applied. The section is chosen after that attack's damage has been fully resolved; a section below 0 HP cannot be chosen.

abilities.name: Fluid Eruption
abilities.summary: Blinding spray in a 3m radius around it (Fortitude negates); only below half HP; costs 10 HP.
abilities.description: Sprays bodily fluids (Range: Caster, Target: 1 area (3m radius)/5); targets that fail a Fortitude check are blinded (CR II p.69) until cured by an effect that removes blindness or until they wipe their face with a Major Action. A Body section can use it only while its HP is below half its maximum (rounded up), and it costs that section 10 HP, which may drop it to 0 HP or below and disable it.

abilities.name: Foot Scooping
abilities.summary: Knocks up to 5 adjacent bipedal characters prone (Danger Sense negates).
abilities.description: The Tail burrows through the ground and sweeps at the targets' feet: up to 5 characters within Range: Touch fall prone unless they succeed on a Danger Sense check. Only bipedal characters with a single section are affected.

description: A giant earthworm of the Alframe swamps, about 20m from mouth to tail and sometimes over 30m; young ones leave home and churn fresh springs or ponds into new mud swamps.

name: Stepping Leaf

abilities.description: It can pose as a stone. The disguise ends automatically once it starts to act. It cannot be found with [Sense Magic]. abilities.description: Combat feats available to it: [Hawk Eye], [Metamagic/Targets], [Targeting], [Wordbreak].

Characters already at the moss's position are unaffected.

abilities.name: Illusory Light

The target first rolls whichever of its Accuracy, Spellcasting or Performance checks has the highest standard value, then must oppose that result with an Evasion or Willpower check (or Accuracy, if it knows [Counter]). A tie or a higher opposing result means no effect; otherwise the illusion throws the target prone, and on its turn it can neither move nor take a Major Action. abilities.name: Toxin Spores

abilities.name: Dangerous Absorption
abilities.summary: A Suction Pad hit latches onto the target; it lets go at the end of its turn unless it used [Suck Blood] or [Minor Break].
abilities.description: When its Suction Pad attack hits, it latches onto the target (no resistance). While attached it can use either [Suck Blood] or [Minor Break] on that target; if its turn ends without using one of them, it lets the target go automatically.

abilities.name: Suck Blood
abilities.summary: 2d magic damage to the character it holds, healing itself by the damage dealt; then lets go.
abilities.description: Drains the character held by [Dangerous Absorption]: 2d magic damage (no resistance), and it recovers HP equal to the damage applied. The target is released afterwards.

abilities.name: Minor Break
abilities.summary: Removes effects with a success value of 0 from the character it holds; then lets go.
abilities.description: Used on the character held by [Dangerous Absorption]: it strips that character of any effect with a success value of 0 (the weakest magic and similar effects; no resistance), then releases the target.

description: A caterpillar-like guard construct of the Magic Civilization that wriggles and leaps about, latches onto intruders with its suckers to drain their fluids and can suck away weak magic, sometimes leaving mana crystals usable as mako stones.
